import.title: Import data
import.intro: Load or update locations, assets, parts and stock, people, suppliers and PM from one Excel workbook. Rows are matched by code: a new code adds a record, a known code updates it. Blank cells keep the current value and nothing is deleted (set Active to No instead). Up to 10 MB and 5,000 rows a sheet.
import.nothing: The file has no sheet CMX knows. Use the template's sheet names.
import.done: Import finished. Rows saved: {{saved}}. Rows skipped for problems: {{skipped}}.

downtime.backRunningHint: Press Back running when the asset runs again, even before the work is completed.
downtime.backRunningOffline: Needs a connection: the stop ends when you press it.
downtime.assetIsDownHint: Starts a stop on the asset's downtime log now; completing the work order ends it.
downtime.assetChangedHint: The stop stays open on the asset chosen before. With the box ticked, a new stop starts now on this asset.
downtime.fromLogEnded: From the asset's downtime log: {{start}} to {{end}}.
downtime.fromLogOpen: From the asset's downtime log: down since {{start}}. Completing the work ends the stop at the actual end.
downtime.deleteBody: Only for a stop that never happened (logged on the wrong asset, or a request ticked down by mistake). Its requests and work orders let go of it, and completed work on it no longer says the asset was down.
downtime.assetMovesHint: The stop this work order started moves to this asset and keeps its start. If this asset is already down, the work order joins that stop.
